name: Bengaluru house price data — asking prices from listings
attribution: Bengaluru house price data, Kaggle (uploader: amitabhajoy)
retrieval_path: Fetched from a GitHub mirror, NOT from Kaggle. Kaggle's API requires an authenticated token; the mirror is unauthenticated, which is what lets the Colab notebook run with no credentials and no setup step.
caveats: UPSTREAM ATTRIBUTION IS RECORDED, LICENCE IS NOT. The Kaggle dataset page is JavaScript-rendered and could not be read programmatically, so the licence is recorded as UNVERIFIED rather than guessed. Confirm it on the dataset page before any redistribution or commercial use.
RETRIEVED FROM A MIRROR, so the mirror's fidelity to the Kaggle original has not been byte-verified. The column set matches the well-known dataset, which is evidence, not proof.
NOT A GOVERNMENT REGISTER. These are ASKING prices scraped from listings, carrying a systematic upward bias of unknown size against transaction prices.
VINTAGE IS UNSTATED. Neither the mirror nor the notebook establishes when these listings were collected, which is why model confidence is capped at 0.45 regardless of validation score.
why_not_kaggle_api: Using the Kaggle API would improve provenance — a dataset page, a version number and a stated licence. It also requires a kaggle.json token, which this project will not handle on a user's behalf and which would break 'Run all' in Colab. The trade is documented rather than hidden: weaker provenance, zero credential handling.
